Imaan waalo! Apne ahd o paimaan aur mu'aamalaat ki paabandi karo. Tumhaare liye tamaam chaupaaye halaal kar diye gaye hain ilaawa un ke jo tumhein padh kar sunaaye ja rahe hain, magar haalat-e-ehraam mein shikaar ko halaal mat samajh lena. Beshak Allah jo chaahta hai hukm deta hai

Imaan waalo! Khabardaar Khuda ki nishaaniyon ki hurmat ko zaaya na karna, aur na mohtaram maheene, qurbaani ke jaanwar aur jin jaanwaron ke gale mein patte baandh diye gaye hain, aur jo log Khaana-e-Khuda ka iraada karne waale hain aur fazl-e-Parwardigar aur razaa-e-Ilaahi ke talabgaar hain, un ki hurmat ki khilaaf-warzi na karna. Aur jab ehraam khatm ho jaaye to shikaar karo. Aur khabardaar kisi qaum ki adaawat faqat is baat par ke us ne tumhein Masjid-ul-Haraam se rok diya hai tumhein zulm par aamaada na kar de. Neki aur taqwa par ek doosre ki madad karo aur gunaah aur ta'addi par aapas mein ta'aawun na karna, aur Allah se darte rehna ke us ka azaab bahut sakht hai

Tumhaare oopar haraam kar diya gaya hai murdaar, khoon, soor ka gosht, aur jo jaanwar ghair-e-Khuda ke naam par zibah kiya jaaye, aur munkhaniqa aur mauqooza aur mutaraddiya aur nateeha, aur jis ko darinda kha jaaye magar yeh ke tum khud zibah kar lo, aur jo nusub par zibah kiya jaaye, aur jis ki teeron ke zariye qur'a-andaazi karo, ke yeh sab fisq hai. Aur kuffaar tumhaare deen se maayoos ho gaye hain, lihaaza tum un se na daro aur mujh se daro. Aaj main ne tumhaare liye deen ko kaamil kar diya hai aur apni ne'maton ko tamaam kar diya hai, aur tumhaare liye deen-e-Islam ko pasandeeda bana diya hai. Lihaaza jo shakhs bhook mein majboor ho jaaye aur gunaah ki taraf maail na ho to Khuda bada bakhshne waala meharbaan hai

Paighambar! Yeh tum se sawaal karte hain ke un ke liye kya halaal kiya gaya hai? To keh dijiye ke tumhaare liye tamaam paakeeza cheezein halaal hain, aur jo kuch tum ne shikaari kutton ko sikha rakha hai aur Khudaai ta'leem mein se kuch un ke hawaale kar diya hai, to jo kuch woh pakad ke laayein use kha lo aur us par naam-e-Khuda zaroor lo, aur Allah se daro ke woh bahut jald hisaab karne waala hai

Aaj tumhaare liye tamaam paakeeza cheezein halaal kar di gayi hain, aur ahl-e-kitaab ka ta'aam bhi tumhaare liye halaal hai aur tumhaara ta'aam un ke liye halaal hai, aur ahl-e-imaan ki aazaad aur paak-daaman auratein ya un ki aazaad auratein jin ko tum se pehle kitaab di gayi hai tumhaare liye halaal hain, basharte ke tum un ki ujrat de do paakeezgi ke saath, na khullam khulla zina ki ujrat ke taur par aur na posheeda taur par dosti ke andaaz se. Aur jo bhi imaan se inkaar karega us ke aamaal yaqeenan barbaad ho jaayenge, aur woh aakhirat mein ghaata uthaane waalon mein hoga

Imaan waalo! Jab bhi namaaz ke liye utho to pehle apne chehron ko aur kohniyon tak apne haathon ko dhoo'o, aur apne sar aur gatte tak pairon ka masah karo. Aur agar janaabat ki haalat mein ho to ghusl karo. Aur agar mareez ho ya safar ke aalam mein ho ya paikhaana waghaira nikal aaya hai ya auraton ko baaham lams kiya hai aur paani na mile to paak mitti se tayammum kar lo, is tarah ke apne chehre aur haathon ka masah kar lo. Ke Khuda tumhaare liye kisi tarah ki zehmat nahin chaahta, balke yeh chaahta hai ke tumhein paak o paakeeza bana de aur tum par apni ne'mat ko tamaam kar de, shaayad tum is tarah us ke shukr-guzaar bande ban jaao

Aur apne oopar Allah ki ne'mat aur us ke us ahd ko yaad karo jo us ne tum se liya hai, jab tum ne yeh kaha ke hum ne sun liya aur itaa'at ki. Aur khabardaar Allah se darte raho ke Allah dil ke raazon ka bhi jaanne waala hai

Imaan waalo! Khuda ke liye qiyaam karne waale aur insaaf ke saath gawaahi dene waale bano, aur khabardaar kisi qaum ki adaawat tumhein is baat par aamaada na kar de ke insaaf ko tark kar do. Insaaf karo ke yahi taqwa se qareeb-tar hai, aur Allah se darte raho ke Allah tumhaare aamaal se khoob baakhabar hai
Allah ne saahibaan-e-imaan aur amal-e-saaleh waalon se wa'da kiya hai ke un ke liye maghfirat aur ajr-e-azeem hai
Aur jin logon ne kufr ikhtiyaar kiya aur hamaari aayaat ki takzeeb ki woh sab ke sab Jahannami hain

Imaan waalo! Apne oopar Allah ki us ne'mat ko yaad karo ke jab ek qaum ne tumhaari taraf haath badhaane ka iraada kiya to Khuda ne un ke haathon ko tum tak pahunchne se rok diya, aur Allah se darte raho ke saahibaan-e-imaan Allah hi par bharosa karte hain

Aur beshak Allah ne Bani Israaeel se ahd liya aur hum ne un mein se baarah naqeeb bheje, aur Khuda ne yeh bhi keh diya ke hum tumhaare saath hain. Agar tum ne namaaz qaaim ki aur zakaat ada ki aur hamaare rasoolon par imaan le aaye aur un ki madad ki aur Khuda ki raah mein qarz-e-hasana diya, to hum yaqeenan tumhaari buraaiyon se darguzar karenge aur tumhein un baaghaat mein daakhil karenge jin ke neeche nahrein jaari hongi. Phir jo us ke baad kufr karega to woh bahut bure raaste ki taraf behak gaya hai

Phir un ki ahd-shikani ki bina par hum ne un par la'nat ki aur un ke dilon ko sakht bana diya. Woh hamaare kalimaat ko un ki jagah se hata dete hain, aur unhon ne hamaari yaad-dihaani ka aksar hissa faraamosh kar diya hai, aur tum un ki khiyaanaton par baraabar mutta'le hote rahoge ilaawa chand afraad ke. Lihaaza un se darguzar karo aur un ki taraf se kinaara-kashi karo ke Allah ehsaan karne waalon ko dost rakhta hai

Aur jin logon ka kehna hai ke hum Nasraani hain hum ne un se bhi ahd liya, aur unhon ne bhi hamaari naseehat (Injeel) ke ek hisse ko faraamosh kar diya, to hum ne ba-taur-e-saza un ke darmiyaan adaawat aur bughz ko qiyaamat tak ke liye raasta de diya, aur anqareeb Khuda inhein un baaton se baakhabar karega jo woh anjaam de rahe the

Ae ahl-e-kitaab! Tumhaare paas hamaara Rasool aa chuka hai jo un mein se bahut si baaton ki wazaahat kar raha hai jin ko tum kitaab-e-Khuda mein se chhupa rahe the, aur bahut si baaton se darguzar bhi karta hai. Tumhaare paas Khuda ki taraf se noor aur raushan kitaab aa chuki hai

Jis ke zariye Khuda apni khushnoodi ka ittibaa' karne waalon ko salaamati ke raaston ki hidaayat karta hai, aur inhein taareekiyon se nikaal kar apne hukm se noor ki taraf le aata hai, aur inhein siraat-e-mustaqeem ki hidaayat karta hai

Yaqeenan woh log kaafir hain jin ka kehna yeh hai ke Maseeh ibn-e-Maryam hi Allah hain. Paighambar! Aap un se kahiye ke phir Khuda ke muqaable mein kaun kisi amr ka saahib-e-ikhtiyaar hoga agar woh Maseeh ibn-e-Maryam aur un ki maa aur saare ahl-e-zameen ko maar daalna chaahe? Aur Allah hi ke liye zameen o aasmaan aur un ke darmiyaan ki kul hukoomat hai. Woh jise bhi chaahta hai paida karta hai aur woh har shai par qudrat rakhne waala hai

Aur Yahoodiyon ne yeh kehna shuroo kar diya ke hum Allah ke farzand aur us ke dost hain. To Paighambar! Aap keh dijiye ke phir Khuda tum par tumhaare gunaahon ki bina par azaab kyon karta hai? Balke tum us ki makhlooqaat mein se bashar ho, aur woh jis ko chaahta hai bakhsh deta hai aur jis par chaahta hai azaab karta hai, aur us ke liye zameen o aasmaan aur un ke darmiyaan ki kul kaainaat hai, aur usi ki taraf sab ki baazgasht hai

Ae ahl-e-kitaab! Tumhaare paas rasoolon ke ek waqfe ke baad hamaara yeh Rasool aaya hai ke tum yeh na kaho ke hamaare paas koi basheer o nazeer nahin aaya tha. To lo yeh basheer o nazeer aa gaya hai, aur Khuda har shai par qaadir hai

Aur us waqt ko yaad karo jab Moosa ne apni qaum se kaha ke ae qaum! Apne oopar Allah ki ne'mat ko yaad karo jab us ne tum mein ambiya qaraar diye aur tumhein baadshaah banaaya aur tumhein woh sab kuch de diya jo aalameen mein kisi ko nahin diya tha
Aur ae qaum! Is arz-e-muqaddas mein daakhil ho jaao jise Allah ne tumhaare liye likh diya hai, aur maidaan se ulte paaon na palat jaao ke ulte khasaare waalon mein se ho jaaoge

Un logon ne kaha ke Moosa! Wahaan to jaabiron ki qaum aabaad hai, aur hum us waqt tak daakhil na honge jab tak woh wahaan se nikal na jaayein. Phir agar woh nikal gaye to hum yaqeenan daakhil ho jaayenge

Magar do insaan jinhein Khuda ka khauf tha aur un par Khuda ne fazl o karam kiya tha, unhon ne kaha ke un ke darwaaze se daakhil ho jaao. Agar tum darwaaze mein daakhil ho gaye to yaqeenan ghaalib aa jaaoge, aur Allah par bharosa karo agar tum saahibaan-e-imaan ho
Un logon ne kaha ke Moosa! Hum hargiz wahaan daakhil na honge jab tak woh log wahaan hain. Aap apne Parwardigar ke saath ja kar jang kijiye, hum yahaan baithe hue hain
Moosa ne kaha Parwardigar! Main sirf apni zaat aur apne bhaai ka ikhtiyaar rakhta hoon, lihaaza hamaare aur is faasiq qaum ke darmiyaan judaai paida kar de
Irshaad hua ke ab un par chaalees saal haraam kar diye gaye ke yeh zameen mein chakkar lagaate rahenge, lihaaza tum is faasiq qaum par afsos na karo

Aur Paighambar! Aap un ko Aadam ke donon farzandon ka sachcha qissa padh kar sunaaiye, ke jab donon ne qurbaani di aur ek ki qurbaani qubool ho gayi aur doosre ki na hui to us ne kaha ke main tujhe qatl kar doonga. To doosre ne jawaab diya ke mera kya qusoor hai, Khuda sirf saahibaan-e-taqwa ke aamaal ko qubool karta hai
Agar aap meri taraf qatl ke liye haath badhaayenge bhi to main aap ki taraf hargiz haath na badhaaoonga, ke main aalameen ke paalne waale Khuda se darta hoon
Main chaahta hoon ke aap mere aur apne donon ke gunaahon ka markaz ban jaaiye aur Jahannamiyon mein shaamil ho jaaiye, ke zaalimeen ki yahi saza hai
Phir us ke nafs ne use bhaai ke qatl par aamaada kar diya aur us ne use qatl kar diya aur woh khasaare waalon mein shaamil ho gaya

Phir Khuda ne ek kauwa bheja jo zameen khod raha tha ke use dikhlaaye ke bhaai ki laash ko kis tarah chhupaaega. To us ne kaha ke afsos! Main is kauwe ke jaisa bhi na ho saka ke apne bhaai ki laash ko zameen mein chhupa deta. Aur is tarah woh naadimeen aur pashemaan logon mein shaamil ho gaya

Isi bina par hum ne Bani Israaeel par likh diya ke jo shakhs kisi nafs ko, kisi nafs ke badle ya roo-e-zameen mein fasaad ki saza ke ilaawa, qatl kar daalega us ne goya saare insaanon ko qatl kar diya, aur jis ne ek nafs ko zindagi de di us ne goya saare insaanon ko zindagi de di. Aur Bani Israaeel ke paas hamaare rasool khuli hui nishaaniyaan le kar aaye magar us ke baad bhi un mein ke aksar log zameen mein ziyaadatiyaan karne waale hi rahe

Bas Khuda o Rasool se jang karne waale aur zameen mein fasaad karne waalon ki saza yahi hai ke inhein qatl kar diya jaaye, ya sooli par chadha diya jaaye, ya un ke haath aur pair mukhtalif samt se qat'a kar diye jaayein, ya inhein arz-e-watan se nikaal baahar kiya jaaye. Yeh un ke liye duniya mein ruswaai hai aur un ke liye aakhirat mein azaab-e-azeem hai
Ilaawa un logon ke jo tumhaare qaaboo mein aane se pehle hi tauba kar lein, to samajh lo ke Khuda bada bakhshne waala meharbaan hai
Imaan waalo! Allah se daro aur us tak pahunchne ka waseela talaash karo aur us ki raah mein jihaad karo ke shaayad is tarah kaamyaab ho jaao

Yaqeenan jin logon ne kufr ikhtiyaar kiya agar un ke paas saari zameen ka sarmaaya ho aur utna hi aur shaamil kar dein ke roz-e-qiyaamat ke azaab ka badla ho jaaye, to yeh mu'aawaza qubool na kiya jaaega aur un ke liye dardnaak azaab hoga
Yeh log chaahte hain Jahannam se nikal jaayein haalaanke yeh nikalne waale nahin hain, aur un ke liye ek mustaqil azaab hai
Chor mard aur chor aurat donon ke haath kaat do ke yeh un ke liye badla aur Khuda ki taraf se ek saza hai, aur Khuda saahib-e-izzat bhi hai aur saahib-e-hikmat bhi hai
Phir zulm ke baad jo shakhs tauba kar le aur apni islaah kar le to Khuda us ki tauba qubool kar lega ke Allah bada bakhshne waala aur meharbaan hai

Kya tum ko nahin maaloom ke zameen o aasmaan ka mulk sirf Khuda hi ke liye hai? Woh jis par chaahta hai azaab karta hai aur jis ko chaahta hai bakhsh deta hai, aur Allah har shai par qaadir o mukhtaar hai

Ae Rasool! Imaan ka da'wa karne waalon mein jo log kufr ki taraf jald-baazi se badh rahe hain un ki harkaat se aap ranjeeda na hon. Yeh sirf zabaan se imaan ka naam lete hain aur un ke dil momin nahin hain. Aur Yahoodiyon mein se bhi ba'z aise hain jo jhooti baatein sunte hain aur doosri qaum waale jo aap ke paas haazir nahin hue inhein sunaate hain. Yeh kalimaat ko un ki jagah se hata dete hain aur logon se kehte hain ke agar Paighambar ki taraf se yahi diya jaaye to le lena aur agar yeh na diya jaaye to parhez karna. Aur jis ke fitne ke baare mein Khuda iraada kar le us ke baare mein aap ka koi ikhtiyaar nahin hai. Yeh woh afraad hain jin ke baare mein Khuda ne yeh iraada hi nahin kiya ke zabardasti un ke dilon ko paak kar dega. Un ke liye duniya mein bhi ruswaai hai aur aakhirat mein bhi azaab-e-azeem hai

Yeh jhoot ke sunne waale aur haraam ke khaane waale hain. Lihaaza agar aap ke paas muqaddama le kar aayein to aap ko ikhtiyaar hai ke faisla kar dein ya e'raaz kar lein. Ke agar e'raaz bhi kar lenge to yeh aap ko koi nuqsaan na pahuncha sakenge, lekin agar faisla hi karein to insaaf ke saath karein ke Khuda insaaf karne waalon ko dost rakhta hai
Aur yeh kis tarah aap se faisla karaayenge jab ke un ke paas Taurait maujood hai jis mein hukm-e-Khuda bhi hai, aur yeh us ke baad bhi munh pher lete hain aur phir imaan laane waale nahin hain

Beshak hum ne Taurait ko naazil kiya hai jis mein hidaayat aur noor hai, aur us ke zariye itaa'at-guzaar ambiya Yahoodiyon ke liye faisla karte hain, aur Allah waale aur ulama-e-Yahood us cheez se faisla karte hain jis ka kitaab-e-Khuda mein un ko muhaafiz banaaya gaya hai aur jis ke yeh gawaah bhi hain. Lihaaza tum un logon se na daro, sirf hum se daro, aur khabardaar thodi si qeemat ke liye hamaari aayaat ka kaarobaar na karna, aur jo bhi hamaare naazil kiye hue qaanoon ke mutaabiq faisla na karega woh sab kaafir shumaar honge

Aur hum ne Taurait mein yeh bhi likh diya hai ke jaan ka badla jaan, aur aankh ka badla aankh, aur naak ka badla naak, aur kaan ka badla kaan, aur daant ka badla daant hai, aur zakhmon ka bhi badla liya jaaega. Ab agar koi shakhs maaf kar de to yeh us ke gunaahon ka bhi kaffaara ho jaaega, aur jo bhi Khuda ke naazil-karda hukm ke khilaaf faisla karega woh zaalimon mein se shumaar hoga

Aur hum ne unhi ambiya ke naqsh-e-qadam par Eesa ibn-e-Maryam ko chala diya jo apne saamne ki Taurait ki tasdeeq karne waale the, aur hum ne inhein Injeel de di jis mein hidaayat aur noor tha, aur woh apne saamne ki Taurait ki tasdeeq karne waali aur hidaayat thi aur saahibaan-e-taqwa ke liye saamaan-e-naseehat thi
Ahl-e-Injeel ko chaahiye ke Khuda ne jo hukm naazil kiya hai us ke mutaabiq faisla karein, ke jo bhi tanzeel-e-Khuda ke mutaabiq faisla na karega woh faasiqon mein shumaar hoga

Aur ae Paighambar! Hum ne aap ki taraf kitaab naazil ki hai jo apne pehle ki Taurait aur Injeel ki musaddiq aur muhaafiz hai, lihaaza aap un ke darmiyaan tanzeel-e-Khuda ke mutaabiq faisla karein, aur Khuda ki taraf se aaye hue haq se alag ho kar un ki khwaahishaat ka ittibaa' na karein. Hum ne sab ke liye alag alag shariat aur raasta muqarrar kar diya hai, aur Khuda chaahta to sab ko ek hi ummat bana deta, lekin woh apne diye hue qaanoon se tumhaari aazmaaish karna chaahta hai. Lihaaza tum sab nekiyon ki taraf sabqat karo ke tum sab ki baazgasht Allah hi ki taraf hai. Wahaan woh tumhein un tamaam baaton se baakhabar karega jin mein tum ikhtilaaf kar rahe the

Aur Paighambar! Aap un ke darmiyaan tanzeel-e-Khuda ke mutaabiq faisla karein aur un ki khwaahishaat ka ittibaa' na karein, aur is baat se bachte rahein ke yeh ba'z ahkaam-e-Ilaahi se munharif kar dein. Phir agar yeh khud munharif ho jaayein to yaad rakhein ke Khuda un ko un ke ba'z gunaahon ki museebat mein mubtala karna chaahta hai, aur insaanon ki aksariyat faasiq aur daaira-e-itaa'at se khaarij hai
Kya yeh log jaahiliyat ka hukm chaahte hain, jab ke saahibaan-e-yaqeen ke liye Allah ke faisle se behtar kis ka faisla ho sakta hai

Imaan waalo! Yahoodiyon aur Eesaaiyon ko apna dost aur sarparast na banaao, ke yeh khud aapas mein ek doosre ke dost hain, aur tum mein se koi inhein dost banaaega to unhi mein shumaar ho jaaega. Beshak Allah zaalim qaum ki hidaayat nahin karta hai

Paighambar! Aap dekhenge ke jin ke dilon mein nifaaq ki beemaari hai woh daud daud kar un ki taraf ja rahe hain aur yeh uzr bayaan karte hain ke humein gardish-e-zamaana ka khauf hai. Pas anqareeb Khuda apni taraf se fatah ya koi doosra amr le aaega to yeh apne dil ke chhupaaye hue raaz par pashemaan ho jaayenge

Aur saahibaan-e-imaan kahenge ke kya yahi log hain jinhon ne naam-e-Khuda par sakht-tareen qasmein khaayi thin ke hum tumhaare saath hain? To ab un ke aamaal barbaad ho gaye aur yeh khasaare waale ho gaye

Imaan waalo! Tum mein se jo bhi apne deen se palat jaaega to anqareeb Khuda ek qaum ko le aaega jo us ki mehboob aur us se mohabbat karne waali, momineen ke saamne khaaksaar aur kuffaar ke saamne saahib-e-izzat, raah-e-Khuda mein jihaad karne waali aur kisi malaamat karne waale ki malaamat ki parwa na karne waali hogi. Yeh fazl-e-Khuda hai, woh jise chaahta hai ata karta hai, aur woh saahib-e-wus'at aur aleem o daana bhi hai
Imaan waalo! Bas tumhaara waali Allah hai aur us ka Rasool aur woh saahibaan-e-imaan jo namaaz qaaim karte hain aur haalat-e-rukoo' mein zakaat dete hain
Aur jo bhi Allah, Rasool aur saahibaan-e-imaan ko apna sarparast banaaega to Allah hi ki jamaa'at ghaalib aane waali hai

Imaan waalo! Khabardaar ahl-e-kitaab mein jin logon ne tumhaare deen ko mazaaq aur tamaasha bana liya hai, aur deegar kuffaar ko bhi apna waali aur sarparast na banaana, aur Allah se darte rehna agar tum waaqe'i saahib-e-imaan ho
Aur jab tum namaaz ke liye azaan dete ho to yeh us ko mazaaq aur khel bana lete hain, is liye ke yeh bilkul be-aql qaum hain

Paighambar! Aap keh dijiye ke ae ahl-e-kitaab! Kya tum hum se sirf is baat par naaraaz ho ke hum Allah aur us ne jo kuch hamaari taraf ya hum se pehle naazil kiya hai un sab par imaan rakhte hain, aur tumhaari aksariyat faasiq aur naafarmaan hai

Kya hum tum ko Khuda ke nazdeek manzilat ke e'tebaar se us se badtar aib ki khabar dein? Ke jis par Khuda ne la'nat aur ghazab naazil kiya hai aur un mein se ba'z ko bandar aur soor bana diya hai, aur jis ne bhi Taaghoot ki ibaadat ki hai woh jagah ke e'tebaar se badtareen aur seedhe raaste se intihaai behka hua hai

Aur yeh jab tumhaare paas aate hain to kehte hain ke hum imaan le aaye hain, haalaanke yeh kufr hi ke saath daakhil hue hain aur usi ko le kar nikle hain, aur Khuda un sab baaton ko khoob jaanta hai jin ko yeh chhupaaye hue hain
Un mein se bahut son ko aap dekhenge ke woh gunaah aur zulm aur haraam-khori mein daudte phirte hain, aur yeh badtareen kaam anjaam de rahe hain
Aakhir inhein Allah waale aur ulama un ke jhoot bolne aur haraam khaane se kyon nahin mana' karte? Yeh yaqeenan bahut bura kar rahe hain

Aur Yahoodi kehte hain ke Khuda ke haath bandhe hue hain, jab ke asl mein unhi ke haath bandhe hue hain aur yeh apne qaul ki bina par mal'oon hain, aur Khuda ke donon haath khule hue hain aur woh jis tarah chaahta hai kharch karta hai. Aur jo kuch aap par Parwardigar ki taraf se naazil hua hai us ka inkaar un mein se bahut son ke kufr aur un ki sarkashi ko aur badha dega. Aur hum ne un ke darmiyaan qiyaamat tak ke liye adaawat aur bughz paida kar diya hai, ke jab bhi jang ki aag bhadkaana chaahenge Khuda bujha dega. Aur yeh zameen mein fasaad ki koshish kar rahe hain aur Khuda mufsidon ko dost nahin rakhta
Aur agar ahl-e-kitaab imaan le aate aur hum se darte rehte to hum un ke gunaahon ko maaf kar dete aur inhein ne'maton ke baaghaat mein daakhil kar dete

Aur agar yeh log Taurait o Injeel aur jo kuch un ki taraf Parwardigar ki taraf se naazil kiya gaya hai sab ko qaaim karte to apne oopar aur qadmon ke neeche se rizq-e-Khuda haasil karte. Un mein se ek qaum miyaana-rau hai aur ziyaada hissa log badtareen aamaal anjaam de rahe hain

Ae Paighambar! Aap us hukm ko pahuncha dein jo aap ke Parwardigar ki taraf se naazil kiya gaya hai, aur agar aap ne yeh na kiya to goya us ke paighaam ko nahin pahunchaaya, aur Khuda aap ko logon ke shar se mahfooz rakhega, ke Allah kaafiron ki hidaayat nahin karta hai

Keh dijiye ke ae ahl-e-kitaab! Tumhaara koi mazhab nahin hai jab tak Taurait o Injeel aur jo kuch Parwardigar ki taraf se naazil hua hai use qaaim na karo. Aur jo kuch aap ke paas Parwardigar ki taraf se naazil hua hai woh un ki kaseer ta'daad ki sarkashi aur kufr mein izaafa kar dega, to aap kaafiron ke haal par ranjeeda na hon

Beshak jo log saahib-e-imaan hain ya Yahoodi aur sitaara-parast aur Eesaai hain, un mein se jo bhi Allah aur aakhirat par waaqe'i imaan laaega aur amal-e-saaleh karega us ke liye na khauf hai aur na use huzn hoga

Hum ne Bani Israaeel se ahd liya hai aur un ki taraf bahut se rasool bheje hain, lekin jab un ke paas koi rasool un ki khwaahish ke khilaaf hukm le aaya to unhon ne ek jamaa'at ki takzeeb ki aur ek giroh ko qatl kar dete hain

Aur un logon ne khayaal kiya ke is mein koi kharaabi na hogi, isi liye yeh haqaaiq se andhe aur behre ho gaye hain. Us ke baad Khuda ne un ki tauba qubool kar li lekin phir bhi aksariyat andhi behri ho gayi, aur Khuda un ke tamaam aamaal par gehri nigaah rakhta hai

Yaqeenan woh log kaafir hain jin ka kehna hai ke Allah hi Maseeh ibn-e-Maryam hain, jab ke khud Maseeh ka kehna hai ke ae Bani Israaeel! Apne aur mere Parwardigar ki ibaadat karo. Jo koi us ka shareek qaraar dega us par Khuda ne jannat haraam kar di hai aur us ka anjaam Jahannam hai, aur zaalimon ka koi madadgaar na hoga

Yaqeenan woh log kaafir hain jin ka kehna yeh hai ke Allah teen mein ka teesra hai, haalaanke Allah ke ilaawa koi khuda nahin hai. Aur agar yeh log apne qaul se baaz na aayenge to un mein se kufr ikhtiyaar karne waalon par dardnaak azaab naazil ho jaaega
Yeh log Khuda ki baargaah mein tauba aur istighfaar kyon nahin karte, jab ke Allah bahut bakhshne waala aur meharbaan hai

Maseeh ibn-e-Maryam kuch nahin hain sirf hamaare rasool hain jin se pehle bahut se rasool guzar chuke hain, aur un ki maa siddeeqa thin, aur woh donon khaana khaaya karte the. Dekho hum apni nishaaniyon ko kis tarah waazeh kar ke bayaan karte hain aur phir dekho ke yeh log kis tarah behke ja rahe hain
Paighambar! Aap un se kahiye ke kya tum Allah ko chhod kar un ki ibaadat karte ho jo tumhaare liye nafa aur nuqsaan ke maalik bhi nahin hain? Aur Khuda sunne waala bhi hai aur jaanne waala bhi hai

Paighambar! Aap keh dijiye ke ae ahl-e-kitaab! Apne deen mein naahaq ghuloo se kaam na lo, aur us qaum ki khwaahishaat ka ittibaa' na karo jo pehle se gumraah ho chuki hai aur bahut se logon ko gumraah bhi kar chuki hai aur seedhe raaste se behak chuki hai
Bani Israaeel mein se kufr ikhtiyaar karne waalon par Janaab-e-Daawood aur Janaab-e-Eesa ki zabaan se la'nat ki ja chuki hai, ke un logon ne naafarmaani ki aur hamesha had se tajaawuz kiya karte the
Unhon ne jo buraai bhi ki hai us se baaz nahin aate the, aur badtareen kaam kiya karte the

Un mein se aksar ko aap dekhenge ke yeh kuffaar se dosti karte hain. Unhon ne apne nafs ke liye jo saamaan pehle se faraaham kiya hai woh bahut bura saamaan hai jis par Khuda un se naaraaz hai, aur woh azaab mein hamesha rehne waale hain
Agar yeh log Allah aur Nabi (Moosa) aur jo kuch un par naazil hua hai sab par imaan rakhte to hargiz kuffaar ko dost na banaate, lekin un mein se bahut se log faasiq aur naafarmaan hain

Aap dekhenge ke saahibaan-e-imaan se sab se ziyaada adaawat rakhne waale Yahoodi aur mushrik hain, aur un ki mohabbat se sab se ziyaada qareeb woh log hain jo kehte hain ke hum Nasraani hain. Yeh is liye hai ke un mein bahut se qissees aur raahib paaye jaate hain aur yeh mutakabbir aur buraai karne waale nahin hain

Aur jab us kalaam ko sunte hain jo Rasool par naazil hua hai to tum dekhte ho ke un ki aankhon se be-saakhta aansoo jaari ho jaate hain ke unhon ne haq ko pehchaan liya hai, aur kehte hain ke Parwardigar! Hum imaan le aaye hain, lihaaza hamaara naam bhi tasdeeq karne waalon mein darj kar le
Bhala hum Allah aur apne paas aane waale haq par kis tarah imaan na laayenge jab ke hamaari khwaahish hai ke Parwardigar humein nek-kirdaar bandon mein shaamil kar le
To is qaul ki bina par Parwardigar ne inhein woh baaghaat de diye jin ke neeche nahrein beh rahi hain, aur woh unhi mein hamesha rehne waale hain, ke yahi nek-kirdaar logon ki jaza hai
Aur jin logon ne kufr ikhtiyaar kar liya aur hamaari aayaat ko jhutla diya to woh log Jahannami hain
Imaan waalo! Jin cheezon ko Khuda ne tumhaare liye halaal kiya hai inhein haraam na banaao aur had se tajaawuz na karo, ke Khuda tajaawuz karne waalon ko dost nahin rakhta hai
Aur jo us ne rizq-e-halaal o paakeeza diya hai us ko khaao, aur us Khuda se darte raho jis par imaan rakhne waale ho

Khuda tum se be-maqsad qasmein khaane par muaakhaza nahin karta hai, lekin jin qasmon ki girah dil ne baandh li hai un ki mukhaalifat ka kaffaara das miskeenon ke liye ausat darje ka khaana hai jo apne ghar waalon ko khilaate ho, ya un ka kapda, ya ek ghulaam ki aazaadi hai. Phir agar yeh sab naamumkin ho to teen roze rakho, ke yeh tumhaari qasmon ka kaffaara hai jab bhi tum qasam kha kar us ki mukhaalifat karo. Apni qasmon ka tahaffuz karo, ke Khuda is tarah apni aayaat ko waazeh kar ke bayaan karta hai ke shaayad tum us ke shukr-guzaar bande ban jaao
Imaan waalo! Sharaab, jua, but, paansa yeh sab gande Shaitaani aamaal hain, lihaaza in se parhez karo taake kaamyaabi haasil kar sako
Shaitaan to bas yahi chaahta hai ke sharaab aur jue ke baare mein tumhaare darmiyaan bughz aur adaawat paida kar de aur tumhein yaad-e-Khuda aur namaaz se rok de, to kya tum waaqe'an ruk jaaoge

Aur dekho Allah ki itaa'at karo aur Rasool ki itaa'at karo aur naafarmaani se bachte raho, warna agar tum ne roo-gardaani ki to jaan lo ke Rasool ki zimmedaari sirf waazeh paighaam ka pahuncha dena hai

Jo log imaan laaye aur unhon ne nek aamaal kiye un ke liye us mein koi harj nahin hai jo kuch kha pi chuke hain, jab ke woh muttaqi ban gaye aur imaan le aaye aur nek aamaal kiye, aur parhez kiya aur imaan le aaye, aur phir parhez kiya aur nek amal kiya, aur (Allah) nek aamaal karne waalon hi ko dost rakhta hai

Imaan waalo! Allah un shikaaron ke zariye tumhaara imtehaan zaroor lega jin tak tumhaare haath aur neze pahunch jaate hain, taake woh yeh dekhe ke us se logon ke ghaaibaana mein bhi kaun kaun darta hai. Phir jo us ke baad bhi ziyaadati karega us ke liye dardnaak azaab hai

Imaan waalo! Haalat-e-ehraam mein shikaar ko na maaro, aur jo tum mein qasdan aisa karega us ki saza unhi jaanwaron ke baraabar hai jinhein qatl kiya hai, jis ka faisla tum mein se do aadil afraad karein, aur us qurbaani ko Ka'be tak jaana chaahiye, ya masaakeen ke khaane ki shakl mein kaffaara diya jaaye, ya us ke baraabar roze rakhe jaayein, taake apne kaam ke anjaam ka maza chakhein. Allah ne guzishta mu'aamalaat ko maaf kar diya hai, lekin ab jo dobaara shikaar karega to us se intiqaam lega, aur woh sab par ghaalib aane waala aur badla lene waala hai

Tumhaare liye daryaai jaanwar ka shikaar karna aur us ka khaana halaal kar diya gaya hai, ke tumhaare liye aur qaaflon ke liye faaide ka zariya hai, aur tumhaare liye khushki ka shikaar haraam kar diya gaya hai jab tak haalat-e-ehraam mein raho, aur us Khuda se darte raho jis ki baargaah mein haazir hona hai

Allah ne Ka'be ko jo Bait-ul-Haraam hai, aur mohtaram maheene ko, aur qurbaani ke aam jaanwaron ko, aur jin jaanwaron ke gale mein patta daal diya gaya hai, sab ko logon ke qiyaam o salaah ka zariya qaraar diya hai, taake tumhein yeh maaloom rahe ke Allah zameen o aasmaan ki har shai se baakhabar hai aur woh kaainaat ki har shai ka jaanne waala hai
Yaad rakho Khuda sakht azaab karne waala bhi hai aur Ghafoor o Raheem bhi hai
Aur Rasool par tableegh ke ilaawa koi zimmedaari nahin hai, aur Allah un sab baaton se baakhabar hai jin ka tum izhaar karte ho ya chhupaate ho

Paighambar! Aap keh dijiye ke khabees aur paakeeza baraabar nahin ho sakte, chaahe khabees ki kasrat achchhi hi kyon na lage. Saahibaan-e-aql! Allah se darte raho, shaayad ke tum is tarah kaamyaab ho jaao

Imaan waalo! Un cheezon ke baare mein sawaal na karo jo tum par zaahir ho jaayein to tumhein buri lagein, aur agar nuzool-e-Quran ke waqt daryaaft kar loge to zaahir bhi kar di jaayengi, aur ab tak ki baaton ko Allah ne maaf kar diya hai, ke woh bada bakhshne waala aur bardaasht karne waala hai
Tum se pehle waali qaumon ne bhi aise hi sawaalaat kiye aur us ke baad phir kaafir ho gaye
Allah ne Baheera, Saaiba, Waseela aur Haam ka koi qaanoon nahin banaaya. Yeh jo log kaafir ho gaye hain woh Allah par jhoota bohtaan baandhte hain, aur un mein ke aksar be-aql hain

Aur jab un se kaha jaata hai ke Khuda ke naazil kiye hue ahkaam aur us ke Rasool ki taraf aao to kehte hain ke hamaare liye wahi kaafi hai jis par hum ne apne aaba o ajdaad ko paaya hai, chaahe un ke aaba o ajdaad na kuch samajhte hon aur na kisi tarah ki hidaayat karte hon

Imaan waalo! Apne nafs ki fikr karo. Agar tum hidaayat-yaafta rahe to gumraahon ki gumraahi tumhein koi nuqsaan nahin pahuncha sakti. Tum sab ki baazgasht Khuda ki taraf hai, phir woh tumhein tumhaare aamaal se baakhabar karega

Imaan waalo! Jab tum mein se kisi ki maut saamne aa jaaye to gawaahi ka khayaal rakhna ke wasiyyat ke waqt do aadil gawaah tum mein se hon, ya phir tumhaare ghair mein se hon agar tum safar ki haalat mein ho aur wahin maut ki museebat naazil ho jaaye. Un donon ko namaaz ke baad rok kar rakho, phir agar tumhein shak ho to yeh Khuda ki qasam khaayein ke hum is gawaahi se kisi tarah ka faaida nahin chaahte hain chaahe qaraabatdaar hi ka mu'aamala kyon na ho, aur na Khudaai shahaadat ko chhupaate hain, ke is tarah hum yaqeenan gunaahgaaron mein shumaar ho jaayenge

Phir agar maaloom ho jaaye ke woh donon gunaah ke haqdaar ho gaye hain to un ki jagah do doosre aadmi khade honge un afraad mein se jo mayyit se qareeb-tar hain, aur woh qasam khaayenge ke hamaari shahaadat un ki shahaadat se ziyaada saheeh hai aur hum ne kisi tarah ki ziyaadati nahin ki hai, ke is tarah zaalimeen mein shumaar ho jaayenge

Yeh behtareen tareeqa hai ke shahaadat ko saheeh tareeqe se pesh karein ya is baat se darein ke kaheen hamaari gawaahi doosron ki gawaahi ke baad radd na kar di jaaye. Aur Allah se darte raho aur us ki suno ke woh faasiq qaum ki hidaayat nahin karta hai
Jis din Khuda tamaam mursaleen ko jama kar ke sawaal karega ke tumhein qaum ki taraf se tableegh ka kya jawaab mila? To woh kahenge ke hum kya bataayein, tu khud hi ghaib ka jaanne waala hai
(Is aayat ka Allama Jawadi ka tarjuma dastiyaab nahin. Online maakhaz mein yahaan ghalti se aayat 116 ka tarjuma dohraaya gaya hai.)
Aur jab hum ne Hawaariyeen ki taraf ilhaam kiya ke hum par aur hamaare rasoolon par imaan le aao, to unhon ne kaha ke hum imaan le aaye aur tu gawaah rehna ke hum Musalmaan hain

Aur jab Hawaariyeen ne kaha ke ae Eesa ibn-e-Maryam! Kya tumhaare Rab mein yeh taaqat bhi hai ke hamaare oopar aasmaan se dastarkhwaan naazil kar de? To unhon ne jawaab diya ke tum agar momin ho to Allah se daro

Un logon ne kaha ke hum chaahte hain ke hum us mein se khaayein aur itminaan-e-qalb paida karein aur yeh jaan lein ke aap ne hum se sach kaha hai, aur hum khud bhi us ke gawaahon mein shaamil ho jaayein

Eesa ibn-e-Maryam ne kaha Khudaya! Parwardigar! Hamaare oopar aasmaan se dastarkhwaan naazil kar de ke hamaare awwal o aakhir ke liye Eid ho jaaye aur teri qudrat ki nishaani ban jaaye, aur humein rizq de ke tu behtareen rizq dene waala hai
Parwardigar ne kaha ke hum naazil to kar rahe hain, lekin us ke baad jo tum mein se inkaar karega us par aisa azaab naazil karenge ke aalameen mein kisi par nahin kiya hai

Aur jab Allah ne kaha ke ae Eesa ibn-e-Maryam! Kya tum ne logon se yeh keh diya hai ke Allah ko chhod kar mujhe aur meri maa ko khuda maan lo? To Eesa ne arz ki ke teri zaat be-niyaaz hai, main aisi baat kaise kahoonga jis ka mujhe koi haq nahin hai. Aur agar main ne kaha tha to tujhe to maaloom hi hai, ke tu mere dil ka haal jaanta hai aur main tere asraar nahin jaanta hoon. Tu, tu ghaib ka jaanne waala bhi hai

Main ne un se sirf wahi kaha hai jis ka tu ne hukm diya tha ke meri aur apne Parwardigar ki ibaadat karo, aur main jab tak un ke darmiyaan raha un ka gawaah aur nigraan raha. Phir jab tu ne mujhe utha liya to tu un ka nigehbaan hai, aur tu har shai ka gawaah aur nigraan hai
Agar tu un par azaab karega to woh tere hi bande hain, aur agar maaf kar dega to saahib-e-izzat bhi hai aur saahib-e-hikmat bhi hai

Allah ne kaha ke yeh qiyaamat ka din hai jab saadiqeen ko un ka sach faaida pahunchaaega, ke un ke liye baaghaat honge jin ke neeche nahrein jaari hongi aur woh un mein hamesha hamesha rahenge. Khuda un se raazi hoga aur woh Khuda se, aur yahi ek azeem kaamyaabi hai
Allah ke liye zameen o aasmaan aur un ke darmiyaan ki kul hukoomat hai, aur woh har shai par qudrat rakhne waala hai
